method: Alinma Fund for Private Equity Investments (holding 50% of Tawzea, received in a financing settlement) was consolidated from 18 Dec 2023 and lost control on 31 Dec 2024 (now a 20.25% associate). The fund's only asset was an equity-accounted joint venture whose result (Tawzea share SAR 6.8m in FY2024) is below TOI.

Dhahban Real Estate Fund (fully owned, set up Sep 2023) was deconsolidated when the bank lost control during 9M2025. Neither the consideration nor the fund's income is disclosed, so the 0.5% materiality test cannot be applied.
notes: Alinma Digital Fund (set up May 2025, controlled from 12 Oct 2025) is a new vehicle, so it is organic. The funds' income sits in investment and other income lines, not in financing income.

method: Alinma IPO Fund (50.1% at 31 Dec 2025) was deconsolidated in 2026 after a partial sale of units; Dhahban Real Estate Fund was consolidated for only part of 9M2025. Consideration and fund income are not disclosed.
notes: Amounts due to the consolidated funds' outside unitholders fell from SAR 100.8m (31 Dec 2025) to SAR 14.5m (30 Sep 2026), which suggests the IPO fund was small, but this is not the consideration test the methodology requires.
